newsitem.title: USA: Mesaba Airlines December load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Mesaba Airlines December load factor up.

text.p: Mesaba Airlines, a unit of Mesaba Holdings Inc, said its December passenger load factor rose 2.3 points to 49.5 percent from 47.2 percent.
Available seat miles were up 23.7 percent to 75.7 million from 61.2 million, and revenue passenger miles gained 29.7 percent to 37.4 million from 28.9 million.
For the 12 months ended December 31, the carrier's load factor advanced 6.2 percentage points to 51.7 percent from 45.5 percent.
Available seat miles were 823.9 million, up 15.4 percent from 714.0 million, and revenue passenger miles increased 31.0 percent to 425.6 million from 324.9 million.
